account.name: Pinecrest Logistics
account.industry: transportation, logistics, supply chain and storage

dossier.summary: Pinecrest Logistics is a regional less-than-truckload carrier with about 280 people, 11 terminals in the Pacific Northwest and a fleet of 160 trucks.
dossier.why_now: Opened a terminal in Spokane in August 2026.

data.title: Filling the Spokane lanes without adding dispatchers
data.intro: A new terminal is the moment the old routing habits either carry over or get replaced. Here is what I would check on the Spokane lanes first, and why it matters for the other ten terminals.

reasons.heading: A new terminal in Spokane
reasons.body: Terminal number eleven adds lanes to and from every other site. Most of the planning for those lanes lands on the same dispatchers who already plan the other ten.

reasons.heading: 160 trucks across 11 terminals
reasons.body: At that size, a truck that leaves half empty from one terminal is hard to see from another. I would want to know how your planners spot that today.

reasons.heading: Regional and less-than-truckload
reasons.body: Short lanes with many stops are where load planning pays off most, because one bad stop order shows up in the driver's day right away. This is where I would start.
